import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 410;
    static final int MAXM = 200020;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final int[] dirX = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dirY = {0, 1, 0, -1};

    static int[] first = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] to = new int[MAXM];
    static int[] nxtE = new int[MAXM];
    static int[] capacity = new int[MAXM];
    static int[] curFlow = new int[MAXM];
    static int edgeCnt;

    static int[] level = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] arc = new int[MAXN];
    static int source, sink;

    static void initGraph() {
        Arrays.fill(first, -1);
        edgeCnt = 0;
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
        to[edgeCnt] = v;
        nxtE[edgeCnt] = first[u];
        capacity[edgeCnt] = c;
        curFlow[edgeCnt] = 0;
        first[u] = edgeCnt++;

        to[edgeCnt] = u;
        nxtE[edgeCnt] = first[v];
        capacity[edgeCnt] = 0;
        curFlow[edgeCnt] = 0;
        first[v] = edgeCnt++;
    }

    static boolean buildLevels() {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        level[source] = 0;
        q.add(source);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int e = first[u]; e != -1; e = nxtE[e]) {
                int v = to[e];
                if (level[v] == -1 && capacity[e] > curFlow[e]) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.add(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[sink] != -1;
    }

    static int sendFlow(int u, int pushed) {
        if (u == sink || pushed == 0) return pushed;
        int sent = 0;
        for (int e = arc[u]; e != -1; e = nxtE[e]) {
            int v = to[e];
            if (level[v] == level[u] + 1 && capacity[e] > curFlow[e]) {
                int tmp = sendFlow(v, Math.min(pushed, capacity[e] - curFlow[e]));
                if (tmp > 0) {
                    curFlow[e] += tmp;
                    curFlow[e ^ 1] -= tmp;
                    pushed -= tmp;
                    sent += tmp;
                    if (pushed == 0) break;
                }
            }
            arc[u] = e; // update arc for next iteration
        }
        return sent;
    }

    static int maxflow(int s, int t) {
        source = s;
        sink = t;
        int ans = 0;
        while (buildLevels()) {
            System.arraycopy(first, 0, arc, 0, first.length);
            ans += sendFlow(source, INF);
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int[][] tim = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] dis = new int[12][12];
    static char[][] g = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] h = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int n, limitT;

    static boolean inside(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n;
    }

    static void bfs1(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) Arrays.fill(tim[i], INF);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(sx * 10 + sy);
        tim[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int code = q.poll();
            int x = code / 10, y = code % 10;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + dirX[k], ny = y + dirY[k];
                if (inside(nx, ny) && g[nx][ny] >= '0' && g[nx][ny] <= '9' && tim[nx][ny] > tim[x][y] + 1) {
                    tim[nx][ny] = tim[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(nx * 10 + ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs2(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) Arrays.fill(dis[i], INF);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(sx * 10 + sy);
        dis[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int code = q.poll();
            int x = code / 10, y = code % 10;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + dirX[k], ny = y + dirY[k];
                if (inside(nx, ny) && h[nx][ny] >= '0' && h[nx][ny] <= '9' && dis[nx][ny] > dis[x][y] + 1) {
                    if (tim[nx][ny] >= dis[x][y] + 1) {
                        dis[nx][ny] = dis[x][y] + 1;
                        if (tim[nx][ny] > dis[nx][ny])
                            q.add(nx * 10 + ny);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        limitT = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                g[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                h[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (g[i][j] == 'Z')
                    bfs1(i, j);

        int S = 0, T = n * n * 2 + 1;
        initGraph();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (g[i][j] > '0' && g[i][j] <= '9')
                    addEdge(S, i * n + j + 1, g[i][j] - '0');
                if (h[i][j] > '0' && h[i][j] <= '9')
                    addEdge(n * n + i * n + j + 1, T, h[i][j] - '0');
            }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (g[i][j] > '0' && g[i][j] <= '9') {
                    bfs2(i, j);
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x)
                        for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y)
                            if (h[x][y] > '0' && h[x][y] <= '9' && dis[x][y] <= limitT)
                                addEdge(i * n + j + 1, n * n + x * n + y + 1, INF);
                }

        System.out.println(maxflow(S, T));
        sc.close();
    }
}
